title: Senior Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>TransferGo</strong> is a growing fintech scale-up on a mission to champion financial freedom with care. We strive to provide tailored, more affordable financial services that make people's hard-earned money go further. Now in our 14th year, with close to 400 employees in offices across Europe and the UK, we’re crafting a brilliant, relevant product that makes a difference in people's lives and the well-being of their families.&nbsp;</p> <p>We’ve come this far by building a talented, diverse workforce on a fair culture and our strong values. Having this strong team of employees, we can serve those who really need our product to make their lives better.&nbsp;</p></div><p>Join us as a Senior Product Designer and help shape how money moves across the globe 💸.</p> <p>At TransferGo, Product Design is not simply a service that turns requirements into screens. Designers are part of the product trio, working alongside Product and Engineering to understand customer problems, shape strategy and deliver experiences that create meaningful customer and business outcomes.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll lead complex initiatives from discovery through delivery across our web and mobile products. You’ll bring clarity to ambiguous problem spaces, connect customer needs with commercial and technical realities, and help teams make better product decisions.</p> <p>You’ll also play an important role in raising the quality of design across TransferGo. Alongside owning your work, you’ll mentor other designers, contribute to our design practice and help us use emerging technologies, including AI to work more effectively without compromising judgement, responsibility or craft.</p> <p>If you’re excited by complex fintech challenges, care deeply about the details and want to help a growing design team increase its impact, we’d love to meet you.</p> <h3><strong>Here’s what you’ll do as a Senior Product Designer:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead significant product initiatives from problem framing and discovery through design, validation, delivery and post-launch iteration</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to define the right problems, shape product direction and balance customer value, business goals and technical feasibility</li> <li>Turn complex financial journeys and requirements into clear, accessible and trustworthy experiences across web and mobile</li> <li>Use qualitative research, behavioural data, experimentation and product metrics to identify opportunities, evaluate trade-offs and measure the impact of your work</li> <li>Plan and conduct appropriate research and validation, including user interviews, usability testing, concept testing and collaborative workshops</li> <li>Develop and communicate a coherent design vision for your initiatives, connecting long-term direction with practical, iterative steps</li> <li>Create high-quality user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, interfaces and specifications, including edge cases and non-ideal states</li> <li>Collaborate with Engineering early and throughout delivery, considering feasibility and ensuring the implemented experience meets the intended quality</li> <li>Contribute to and evolve our design system, creating reusable patterns and improving consistency between design and production</li> <li>Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully throughout the design process; for example, to support research synthesis, problem framing, exploration, content design, rapid prototyping, data analysis and design reviews</li> <li>Evaluate AI-generated work critically, protecting customer privacy and applying human judgement to accuracy, accessibility, quality and appropriateness</li> <li>Communicate recommendations and design decisions clearly, using evidence and storytelling to build alignment and influence stakeholders</li> <li>Mentor and support other designers through critique, feedback and practical guidance, helping raise the team’s overall quality and confidence</li> <li>Improve the way we work by identifying opportunities to make design processes faster, clearer and more effective</li> </ul> <p>You’ll report to our Head of Product Design.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring:</strong></h3> <p>We don’t expect you to meet every single requirement listed. What matters most is your motivation, mindset and ability to learn. If you’re excited about this role and think you could be a great fit, we’d really like to hear from you.</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products within cross-functional product teams</li> <li>A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership, strategic product thinking, polished UX/UI craft and measurable customer or business impact</li> <li>A track record of independently leading complex initiatives from an ambiguous starting point through discovery, delivery and iteration</li> <li>Strong product judgement and the ability to balance desirability, usability, viability, feasibility and delivery constraints</li> <li>Advanced interaction and visual design skills, with close attention to detail, accessibility, consistency and usability</li> <li>Strong systems thinking, including an understanding of how design decisions affect connected journeys, platforms, teams and future product development</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and component-based workflows, with experience contributing to or evolving design systems</li> <li>Confidence choosing and applying appropriate research and validation methods rather than relying on a single process for every problem</li> <li>Experience using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions and evaluate outcomes</li> <li>Practical familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows or clear evidence of actively developing this capability across areas such as ideation, research synthesis, content, prototyping, analytics or design review</li> <li>The ability to assess AI output critically, recognise its limitations and use it responsibly rather than treating it as a replacement for customer insight or professional judgement</li> <li>Strong communication, facilitation and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain decisions and influence stakeholders across disciplines and levels</li> <li>A proactive approach to collaboration with Product and Engineering, including involving partners early and navigating constraints constructively</li> <li>The ability to organise design artefacts and documentation so that decisions, specifications and context are easy for others to understand</li> <li>The confidence to challenge assumptions, give and receive constructive feedback, and change direction when evidence calls for it</li> <li>The ability to balance speed and quality, make pragmatic trade-offs and move work forward without waiting for perfect information</li> <li>A user-first, low-ego approach grounded in curiosity, empathy, accountability and a strong sense of ownership</li> <li>Fluent English language skills</li> </ul> <h3><strong>And if you can also do this stuff, even better:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing fintech, payments, banking, SaaS or other complex and regulated digital products</li> <li>Experience designing products for customers across different countries, languages, levels of financial literacy or accessibility needs</li> <li>Experience working with complex data, experimentation platforms or product analytics tools</li> <li>Familiarity with design tokens, Code Connect, code-backed prototyping or other workflows that help close the gap between design and implementation</li> <li>Experience building or sharing AI-assisted workflows, prompt libraries, design-review practices or rapid prototyping approaches</li> <li>Experience contributing to product strategy, roadmap conversations or cross-team initiatives beyond your immediate product area</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we believe</strong></h3> <p><strong>At TransferGo</strong>, we offer competitive rewards to all people. We know that recognition is about more than just money, and we’ve fostered a culture of kudos to shine a light on the great work throughout the business, and the people making it all happen. We hold regular in person events to connect with each other and help all our TransferNauts to grow with a generous training allowance. We believe that empowering people makes for a happier and more effective workforce. This means we enable anyone who wants to pursue initiatives that deliver real value for our migrant customers.</p> <h3><strong>What We Offer:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive Salary</strong>: Starting from 4,420 GBP - 6600 GBP (gross) per month, depending on experience. Salary is just one part of the conversation – if you’re excited about the role but the range feels slightly off, don’t hesitate to apply. We’re open to discussing based on your experience and potential.</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive Benefits</strong>: Including a generous holiday allowance, competitive healthcare insurance, and a wellbeing package from day one.</li> <li><strong>Annual Development Budget</strong>: €1,000 to invest in your personal and professional growth.</li> <li><strong>Hybrid Working Environment</strong>: Flexibility to work from home and in the office, with most team members in the office two days a week.</li> <li><strong>Pet-Friendly Office</strong>: If you’re near one of our offices, bring your furry friend along!</li> <li><strong>Inclusive Culture</strong>: Regular in-person events, fostering a strong sense of community and collaboration.</li> <li><strong>Empowerment and Ownership</strong>: We believe in empowering our people to take initiative and drive meaningful change.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>At TransferGo, we are committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity,&nbsp; marriage, civil partnership or any other protected category. We are proud of our diverse and inclusive culture and we strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join TransferGo. We look forward to meeting you! </em></strong></p> <p><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">Please note that all data collected will be handled in accordance with our candidates privacy policy (<a href="https://www.transfergo.com/privacy-policy/overview">https://www.transfergo.com/privacy-policy/overview</a>) </em><em data-stringify-type="italic">and will only be used for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy. description: <p><strong>Soho, London</strong></p> <p><strong>Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs</strong></p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Team, taking a leading role in building the complex, scalable systems that power our data strategy. You will lead architectural discussions, own the design of business-critical data solutions and deliver high-quality systems that bring millions of fans closer to the sports they love. This is a fantastic opportunity to lead the optimisation of our data platforms for real-time AI/ML workloads, mentor engineers and make a significant impact on our business. The Senior Data Engineer leads technical initiatives, maintains data integrity and performance, and works across teams to translate complex business requirements into effective data solutions. The role also uses automation and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, decision-making and productivity across the organisation.</p> <p>At LiveScore Group, we’re the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We’re proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan’s passion for sport driving us to the top.</p> <p>We don’t just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it’s our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you’re good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.</p> <p><em>We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you’re passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you!</em><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the design and delivery of robust data pipelines using GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage. This includes integrating data from various sources, ensuring data quality and enabling real-time processing capabilities.</li> <li>Own the design of data models and databases that support business analytics and intelligence, using dimensional data-modelling principles. Select and use GCP database technologies such as Bigtable, Spanner or Firestore to optimise performance and scalability.</li> <li>Lead the automation of data workflows and optimisation of data storage and processing costs within GCP. Use tools such as Cloud Composer for orchestration and establish best practices in performance tuning.</li> <li>Ensure data security by implementing GCP security practices. Provide technical leadership and guidance to team members.</li> <li>Evaluate new GCP features and data-engineering technologies, setting technical direction where they can enhance data infrastructure or enable new data products.</li> <li>Lead the resolution of critical pipeline failures and data-quality incidents, performing fault analysis and ensuring that preventative improvements are implemented.</li> <li>Lead critical system-design and architectural decisions for scalable batch and real-time workloads.</li> <li>Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into effective and innovative data solutions.</li> <li>Mentor engineers, review technical designs and foster a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.</li> <li>Own improvements to the reliability, performance and cost-effectiveness of data systems.</li> <li><span data-teams="true">Lead the design and maintenance of robust, secure integrations with core internal systems and critical third-party platforms.</span></li> <li><span data-teams="true">Define appropriate monitoring and alerting standards to ensure high system reliability and minimal downtime.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills, Knowledge and Experience</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in data engineering or data warehousing with large-scale, complex datasets.</li> <li>Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience using AI-assisted development tools appropriately.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of data-modelling techniques.</li> <li>Deep experience with cloud data services and technologies, ideally within the GCP ecosystem, such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery or Vertex AI.</li> <li>Proven experience designing and implementing robust ELT pipelines, including real-time and large-scale batch processing.</li> <li>Proven ability to deploy and maintain data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles and tools such as Terraform.</li> <li>Experience with Airflow environment management and Docker.</li> <li>Experience contributing to an AI roadmap and evaluating AI tooling, including coding agents, for use within the development lifecycle.</li> <li>The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience applying data-governance, privacy and security best practices in a regulated environment.</li> <li>A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to anticipate and resolve system inefficiencies.</li> <li>The ability to lead cross-functional technical work and translate complex or ambiguous requirements into robust data solutions.</li> <li>A track record of taking end-to-end ownership for the quality, reliability and performance of business-critical data solutions.</li> <li>Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical standards across a team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What can we offer?</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Company Performance Bonus</li> <li>Flexible Working Agreements where applicable</li> <li>Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance</li> <li>Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental &amp; Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay</li> <li>Subsidised Gym Membership</li> <li>Annual Travel Card Loan &amp; Ride to Work Scheme</li> <li>Life Assurance (x3 salary)</li> <li>Contributory Pension Plan</li> <li>Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences</li> <li>Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We help restaurants maximize revenue, improve operational efficiency, and deliver exceptional guest experiences through data-driven recommendations, proactive partnership, and deep product expertise.</p> <p>We are a fast-paced, highly collaborative team that values strategic thinking, accountability, curiosity, and customer impact. curious</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p>Successful CSMs at SevenRooms:</p> <ul> <li>Operate proactively and anticipate customer risks and opportunities before they surface</li> <li>Influence customers to take action and adopt best practices that drive measurable business outcomes</li> <li>Prioritize effectively across a large and diverse portfolio of accounts</li> <li>Build trusted relationships while balancing empathy with accountability</li> <li>Use data and operational insights to drive strategic recommendations</li> <li>Create urgency around growth opportunities and operational improvements</li> <li>Act as strategic partners to hospitality operators</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About DoorDash</strong></p> <p>At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.&nbsp;</p> <p>DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Reporting to the Recoveries and Litigation Manager, the Recoveries Agent will be responsible for completing a wide range of administrative activities within strict timescales to meet the needs of our customers, our third party suppliers including debt collection agencies, recovery agents and vehicle auction houses, as well as internally within the wider business.

The Recoveries Team plays a crucial role in asset management by ensuring the timely retrieval of our vehicles. This involves close coordination and communication with external recovery agents and auction houses to schedule and facilitate the collection process. The team is also responsible for managing the complexities involved in recovering impounded or seized vehicles, which may require interaction with legal authorities and adherence to specific procedures. Additionally, the Recoveries Team handles incoming communications from recovery agents and auction houses, responding to inquiries, providing necessary information, and addressing any issues that may arise during the recovery process.

What you’ll be doing

  • Effectively respond to inbound customer and third party supplier communications through multiple channels including debt collection agencies, recovery agents and auction houses.

  • Initiate outbound communications (calls and emails) to recovery agents and other third party suppliers when necessary.

  • Evaluate customers’ financial circumstances to determine their ability to repay their arrears and recommend appropriate solutions.

  • Follow company policies and legal regulations regarding financial support practices, including documenting all communication with customers and update account information accurately in the company's systems.

  • Review potential accounts for placement with third party suppliers and instruct appropriate suppliers accordingly.

  • Issue Statutory Notices to customers including Notices of Default and Termination, as well as regulatory notices on post-terminated accounts.

  • Deal with accounts where the vehicle has been seized and impounded.

  • Complete administrative tasks as required for the efficient operation of internal processes and external supplier processes. This may also include training material preparation and any other administrative requirement identified by management.

  • Ensure that our customers are treated fairly at all times in line with Consumer Duty.

  • Support the wider team and take the lead in the Recoveries and Litigation Managers absence.

  • Stay up to date on industry trends, regulations and best practices in financial support and recoveries.

What we’re looking for

  • Previous recoveries experience in motor finance is preferred but not essential.

  • Experience taking ownership for managing processes and speaking to external parties.

  • Good understanding of procedures, systems and processes within the department.

  • Logical and common sense approach to evaluate situations and select appropriate solutions based on experience and an understanding of procedures.

  • Strong prioritisation skills, ability to organise and work independently.

  • Resilient and calm approach when faced with difficult situations.

  • Takes responsibility and demonstrates accountability to ensure high-quality output.

  • Able to adapt written and verbal communication to an individual's needs.

Who you are:

  • Be a team player, flexible and able to work on your own initiative.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish effective working relationships at all levels.

  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail for maintaining accurate records and documentation.

  • Demonstrates a sense of urgency and good work ethic.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Rapport building with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

  • Ability to work to deadlines.

  • Problem solving skills.

  • Ability to operate comfortably in a fast paced and changing environment.

Interview process

  • 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team

  • A Take Home Task

  • Interviews with the Recoveries & Litigation Manager as well as other key stakeholders

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: IT Systems Engineer
description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role We're hiring a IT Systems Engineer to own the reliability and evolution of the tools every team at OLIX depends on day to day: identity and SSO, device management across Mac and Windows, Google Workspace, and the wider collaboration and business-systems stack including Slack, Notion and Atlassian. As headcount grows, so does the load on these systems, and we need someone to own their architecture and roadmap rather than just keep them running. You'll be the final escalation point for complex, cross-system problems, and you'll lead company-wide systems projects from scoping through delivery. A significant identity provider and device management migration is on the near-term roadmap, so there's substantial architectural work from day one. Beyond the core stack, you'll act as OLIX's AI enabler: finding the manual tools and processes worth removing, evaluating tools, and building agents and automations that act as a force multiplier across the business, all while holding a high bar on security and IP protection. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define how IT and internal systems work here from the ground up. Responsibilities Strengthen the core stack: own the architecture and roadmap for our business-systems stack, including IDP/IAM, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Atlassian and adjacent HRIS, ATS and finance platforms, and make sure they scale ahead of OLIX's growth. Lead IT and systems projects end to end: take medium-to-large, company-wide projects from scoping through delivery, automating recurring work, streamlining tooling, and improving the day-one and day-to-day experience for every OLIX employee. Be the escalation point: act as the final escalation point for complex, cross-system issues, providing expert-level root cause analysis and implementing architectural changes that stop problems recurring. Build agents and automations: champion AI adoption across the business, partnering with functional teams to design scalable, automated processes and building the tools, scripts and workflows (Google Workspace and Apps Script, IDP APIs) that eliminate manual toil. Own secure onboarding of new tools: partner with InfoSec on SaaS vendor reviews and rollout, so new tools arrive with SSO, SCIM and least-privilege access in place. Raise the bar as you go: find and fix friction or quality gaps in how IT and systems operate without being asked, mentor others, and be a visible example of ownership in the team. Skills & Experience 3+ years in IT systems engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end rather than working tickets within someone else's design. Expert-level knowledge of Windows and Mac device management, Google Workspace administration, and Google Cloud Identity across users, devices and applications. Deep, hands-on experience with SSO and identity platforms, ideally Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud. Experience rebuilding or migrating between identity providers is a strong plus given our roadmap. Experience administering SaaS and collaboration tools at company scale, Slack, Notion and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) in particular. An AI-first mindset: a practical focus on using AI and LLM-powered tools to streamline IT operations, improve user self-service and automate repetitive work, and a habit of building agents that act as force multipliers for the business. Coding and scripting experience in one or more general-purpose languages, plus familiarity with Google Workspace developer tools (Apps Script, Workspace APIs). Solid grasp of IT security fundamentals: role-based access control, least-privilege access, MDM, data security and identity best practice. Proven ownership: a track record of taking ambiguous, medium-to-large problems and driving them to durable resolution without heavy oversight. Nice to have: exposure to a fast-moving hardware or deep-tech startup, and comfort with infrastructure-as-code-style change management culture. Compensation & Equity Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You're not just joining the mission; you're owning a piece of it Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security. Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Risk Manager
description: Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth. We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Over the past few years, our client base has grown 20 times to over 4 million, and client assets have grown over 50 times to over €5 billion. Role Overview The Senior Risk Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the business to embed the Risk Management Framework and manage and mitigate risks across the organisation. You will be responsible for liaising with the first line of defence to support them in identifying and understanding their risk profile, assessing the design and effectiveness of controls and procedures, ensuring these align with internal policies. This role requires a deep understanding of financial markets, trading practices, and global best practices for risk management frameworks. What you’ll do Ensure the organisation’s approach to the management of risk is aligned with its risk appetite and strategy. Facilitate delivery and maintenance of Risk and Control Risk Assessments (RCSAs), ensuring appropriate oversight of risk identification, assessment and treatment are performed in line with risk appetite. Perform periodic independent second line of defence assurance through the delivery of individual controls testing and thematic assurance reviews. Identify gaps in the control environment and work with the first line of defence to determine remediation plans, ensuring progress is tracked and reported on through governance. Deliver Top-Down Risk Assessments through engaging with senior management and subject matter experts to identify material risks the Firm are exposed to. Maintenance of the legal entity Risk Register and overseeing the maintenance of thematic Risk Registers, including the Fraud Risk Register, Market Abuse Risk Register and Business Wide Financial Crime Risk Assessment. Participating in the ICARA process, ensuring all relevant risks are captured, quantified and adequately stressed. Providing oversight of risk events by working with first line colleagues to understand the root cause of events, their impact on the Firm and what corrective and preventive actions are required to remediate. Demonstrating a solid understanding of liquidity risk management. Delivering coherent, transparent and rigorous risk governance reporting. Delivery of Risk projects to develop, evolve and enhance both the design and embeddedness of the Firm’s Risk Management Framework and supporting processes. Provide an overview and challenge of the trading risk to which the firm is exposed. Ensure appropriate horizon scanning processes are implemented to identify and manage emerging risks. Providing second line risk reviews for new product and feature launches, and strategic and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring risk is identified from the offset, with downstream impacts managed and aligned to risk appetite. Support the identification and enhancement of both qualitative and quantitative risk appetite measures, ensuring these are tracked with any breach escalated and remediated in line with risk appetite.   • Perform periodic independent second line of defence assurance through the delivery of individual controls testing and thematic assurance reviews.

  • Identify gaps in the control environment and work with the first line of defence to determine remediation plans, ensuring progress is tracked and reported on through governance.

  • Maintenance of the legal entity Risk Register and overseeing the maintenance of thematic Risk Registers, including the Fraud Risk Register, Market Abuse Risk Register and Business Wide Financial Crime Risk Assessment.

  • Participating in the ICARA process, ensuring all relevant risks are captured, quantified and adequately stressed.

  • Demonstrating a solid understanding of liquidity risk management.

  • Delivery of Risk projects to develop, evolve and enhance both the design and embeddedness of the Firm’s Risk Management Framework and supporting processes.

Domain Experience: Background in the e-Learning, Learning Management (LMS), or Human Capital Management (HCM) industries. Scalability Specialist: Direct experience consulting on platform performance, high availability, uptime, and enterprise scalability. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing. title: Product Manager
description: <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)&nbsp;</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Predictable performance, even at scale </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Secure, compliant environments by default&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Real-time observability and profiling built in </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack </span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our values:&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">🌿 We make a positive impact.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">✨ We aim for the stars.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">💚 We care for each other.&nbsp;</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Impact of a Product Manager</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategy and roadmap:</strong> Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Problem definition:</strong> Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Solution definition:</strong> Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Ship small, iterate fast:</strong> Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Technical execution:</strong> Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Design for humans and agents:</strong> Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Customer and data authority:</strong> Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Influence across teams:</strong> Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Go-to-market:</strong> Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What you bring</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Product management experience:</strong> Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Technical depth:</strong> Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Software development background:</strong> Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>AI fluency:</strong> Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Agentic development:</strong> A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.</span></p> verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Data-informed decision making:</strong> Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Bonus points for</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes</span></p> </li> </ul> title: Stage - Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F)
description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous ! Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75).  Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants : Data Analyse Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien : Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s. Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes. Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers. Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes. Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe. Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet : Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement. Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.). Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow. Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps. Requirements Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science / Machine Learning. Une maîtrise suffisante de SQL est essentielle. Des connaissances en Python seront valorisées. Compréhension des algorithmes de Machine Learning et un fort intérêt pour le NLP. Sensible aux problématiques business : vous êtes animé(e) par l’envie de comprendre nos clients, nos produits et nos process pour générer de l'impact. Compétences en visualisation de données pour restituer vos analyses de manière claire. Vous êtes rigoureux(se), structuré(e) et avez un fort esprit d'équipe. Force de proposition : vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement où il reste des choses à construire. Ce que ce stage vous apportera : Une montée en compétences technique pointue en Python et SQL. L’opportunité de travailler sur une stack data moderne et robuste (AWS, Redshift, Metaflow, Git, etc.). Le passage de la théorie à la pratique : vous verrez votre code et vos modèles partir en production. L’affinage de votre sens métier et de votre esprit critique au contact d'équipes variées (Tech, E-commerce, CRM, Marketing). Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Post-doctorante ou post-doctorant en Informatique - CDD 12 Mois
description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) ! Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé. 🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions. 💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali. Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne).  Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.   Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.   Vos missions principales : Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides. Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge. Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle. Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.   Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un : Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche. Profil scientifique recherché : Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques. Appétence pour le domaine de la santé. Compétences attendues : Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité. Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets. Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude. Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international. Vos atouts supplémentaires : Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle. Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java). Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique. 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde . Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver : ·  Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain ·  Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an · Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail. Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science , l’ ingénierie , et des projets qui font sens . 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! Notre engagement en faveur de la diversité nourrit notre innovation et nos stratégies pour faire bouger les lignes, réinventer l'activation média et créer des histoires percutantes pour nos clients internationaux et leurs consommateurs. Développer une connaissance approfondie de notre portefeuille de services et de notre offre marketing intégrée pour identifier à terme les besoins de nos clients et y répondre au mieux. Vous voyez les défis comme des opportunités et recherchez activement des retours d'expérience pour faire évoluer vos compétences. Vous aimez apprendre à connaître vos clients, bâtir des relations durables et apporter de la valeur ajoutée à leur activité. raw.description:
Job title: Senior Data Engineer

Department: Data team

Reports to: Lead Data Engineer

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Permanent, local and full-time 

Starting date: ASAP 2026

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

 

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.


We are looking for someone with: 

  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

  • Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus).

  • Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus).

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.


⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

  • You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: CFDT and FO confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

  • You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

  • You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

  • Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

⭐️ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

  • Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

  • Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

  • Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

  • Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

  • Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

  • Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations: in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

  • Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

  • Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem: branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

  • Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

  • Have outstanding stakeholder management: calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

  • Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

  • Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.

Nice to have:

  • A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

  • Experience inside a paritariste institution

  • Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

  • Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

  • International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

  • Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

raw.description:
